_readme: OWCS FACEIT matchroom URLs. The batch ingest (pipeline/ingest_faceit_batch.py)
reads this list, and the desktop application appends to it when you paste a
FACEIT link. Each entry needs a url; region/stage/notes are optional metadata
used to tag the match. Duplicate urls or match ids are skipped.
FACEIT supplies match FACTS ONLY — teams, rosters, schedule, series result,
bracket, bans. It never produces hero compositions; those come only from CV
PLACEHOLDER ENTRIES ARE NOT ALLOWED HERE, for the same reason they are not
allowed in video_sources.json. A row reading
list. It could never resolve to a real matchroom, so every batch ingest and
every scheduled update-data run carried one guaranteed failed source, which
trains an operator to ignore ingest failures. It also invited someone to fill
in half of it. Add a room only once it is a real OWCS matchroom URL.
An EMPTY list is the correct state when no rooms are queued: the batch ingest
reports that there is nothing to do and exits cleanly. Enforced by
